author: GameTrailers
description:
Don't miss this behind the scenes developer interview for Creative Assembly and SEGA's highly anticipated follow up to Alien Isolation. Ana Sopikova and Laura Mauterer, Art Director and Principal UI Artist respectively, go over questions regarding to the development of Alien Isolation 2. 
Alien Isolation 2 is coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5), Nintendo Switch 2, PC (Steam) and Xbox Series X|S.
title: Alien Isolation 2 - Official Developer Interview

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's your look at the announcement trailer for Dungoku, an upcoming pixel-art Sudoku puzzler game. Crawl your way through dark dungeons, outsmart the undead and earn your keep in Dungoku - a pixel-art Sudoku puzzler with an undead twist and retro vibes! Dungoku will be available on PC.
title: Dungoku - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the latest update for Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2, the action shooter from Focus Entertainment. The Decimation Update brings all new customization options, a new PVP mode and a rework for the Vanguard class! 
Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2 is out now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Nintendo Switch 2, PC (Steam), and Xbox Series X|S.
title: Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2 - Official Decimation Update Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Bawma from 007 First Light has contracted Agent 47 to eliminate traitorous members of his crew in this brand new update for Hitman World of Assassination, the stealth action game from IO Interactive! Lenny Kravitz returns to provide his likeness and voice to the Bond villain, and you can take on his contract November 26th - December 24th, 2026!
title: Hitman World of Assassination - Official Bawma's Elusive Targets Trailer (ft. Lenny Kravitz)

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the trailer for Appulse, the roguelite pinball top-down shooter from Raw Fury and Le Rado! 
Master the use of flippers and recoil with precision, craft your own ship and loadout, and climb the scoreboard in a race to the top in an intergalactic war! 
Appulse is out now for PC (Steam).
title: Appulse - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the console launch trailer for The Spotter: Dig or Die from Puppyroar games! Build your home base, scavenge resources and build big guns to destroy waves of mutants coming to take your turf! 
The Spotter: Dig or Die is out now for PC (Steam), PlayStation 5 (PS5) and Xbox Series X|S.
title: The Spotter: Dig or Die - Official Console Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Cast your line, upgrade your gear, and become the ultimate angler in this cozy incremental fishing adventure. Check out the Fishing Inc. mobile launch trailer to see gameplay and more. Fishing Inc invites players to embark on a relaxing fishing adventure where every catch brings them one step closer to becoming the ultimate angler. Starting with simple equipment and modest catches, players will explore new fishing spots, discover a wide variety of species, and steadily build their fishing skills.

Fishing Inc. is available now on iOS and Android. It is also out on PC.
title: Fishing Inc - Official Mobile Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the trailer for the latest update for The Witcher 3 Remastered from CD Projekt Red. Cross-Platform Mod Support is coming to The Witcher 3 Wild Hunt with this latest free update, featuring a myriad of curated player mods, given official support by CD Projekt Red. Give Geralt all new hairstyles, glowing eyes and the Hearts of Stone brand, with all new gameplay quests available for download from inside the game. 
The Witcher 3 Remastered is out now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), PC (Steam, GoG) and Xbox Series X|S.
title: The Witcher 3 Wild Hunt Remastered - Official Cross-Platform Mod Support Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Station to Station is available now on PlayStation 5 (PS5) and Nintendo Switch 2. It is also available on PC. Get another look at the voxel-art world of Station to Station in this trailer for the minimalist and relaxing game about building railway connections. Grab your conductor’s hat and bring the voxel-art world to life through the magic of trains!
title: Station to Station - Official Console Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out gameplay from Chaos Islands in this trailer for the upcoming city-builder that unites deck-building and tower defense mechanics with roguelite elements. As the last bastion of humanity forced to escape to the skies to hide from invading forces of demons. Protect your settlement and do not let the evil forces pass.

Chaos Islands will be available on PC in 2027. The Playtest begins on Steam on December 4, 2026.
title: Chaos Islands - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the trailer for the latest DLC, Poolside Paradise, for Hotel Architect. Two new hotels have opened up on the Canary Islands and your guests are jetting in from all over the world! 
Hotel Architect is out now for PC (Steam)
title: Hotel Architect - Official Poolside Paradise Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Don't miss this extensive look at Infinity Nikki's 3.0 launch trailer, Ingold Games open-world fashion adventure game! With a staggering amount of content, you'll be able to enjoy new sights and sounds across two new cities, new outfits that grant special abilities, new weapon classes, new vehicles, new characters and much more! 

Infinity Nikki 3.0 launches November 26th for PlayStation 5 (PS5), PC (Steam), iOS and Android.
title: Infinity Nikki - Official 3.0 Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Enjoy some new gameplay from the cel-shaded mech roguelite shooter Tin Coffins as it reveals its release date: December 7 on Steam. Wishlist it if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4943260/Tin_Coffins/
title: Tin Coffins: Official Release Date Trailer
